SELECT m.*, COUNT(p.participant_id) AS current_people, CASE WHEN f.match_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS favorite FROM personal_match m LEFT JOIN personal_match_participant p ON m.personal_match_id = p.personal_match_id LEFT JOIN favorite f ON f.match_id = m.personal_match_id AND f.match_type = 'Personal' AND f.user_id = #{userId} WHERE 1=1 AND coalesce(m.deleted, 0) = 0 AND m.status ='모집중'
AND m.sport IN
#{sport}
AND (
m.region LIKE CONCAT('%', #{region}, '%')
)
GROUP BY m.personal_match_id
ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
ORDER BY current_people DESC
ORDER BY m.deadline ASC
ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT m.*, COUNT(p.participant_id) AS current_people, CASE WHEN f.match_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS favorite FROM personal_match m LEFT JOIN personal_match_participant p ON m.personal_match_id = p.personal_match_id LEFT JOIN favorite f ON f.match_id = m.personal_match_id AND f.match_type = 'PERSONAL' AND f.user_id = #{userId} WHERE m.latitude BETWEEN #{minLat} AND #{maxLat} AND m.longitude BETWEEN #{minLng} AND #{maxLng} AND coalesce(m.deleted, 0) = 0 AND m.status ='모집중'
AND m.sport IN
#{sport}
AND (
m.age_20s = true
m.age_30s = true
m.age_40s = true
m.age_50s = true
m.age_60_plus = true
)
AND (
m.skill_intro = true
m.skill_beginner = true
m.skill_intermediate = true
m.skill_advanced = true
)
AND m.gender = #{gender}
GROUP BY m.personal_match_id ORDER BY m.created_at DESC

SELECT m.*, u.nickname, COUNT(p.participant_id) AS current_people, CASE WHEN f.match_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS favorite FROM personal_match m LEFT JOIN personal_match_participant p ON m.personal_match_id = p.personal_match_id AND p.status = "결제완료" LEFT JOIN user u ON m.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN favorite f ON f.match_id = m.personal_match_id ON m.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN favorite f ON f.match_id = m.personal_match_id AND f.match_type = 'Personal' AND f.user_id = #{userId} WHERE m.personal_match_id = #{personalMatchId}
GROUP BY m.personal_match_id ORDER BY m.created_at DESC;
